description: This file defines the 'ViewLeaveEntitlementController' class, a PHP controller within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It manages the preparation of data and components for viewing leave entitlements, including handling employee details, leave types, and leave periods. It interacts with various services and traits to fetch and process data, and sets up Vue components and properties for rendering in the frontend.

classes.name: ViewLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class for viewing leave entitlements, extending AbstractVueController, using traits for user role management, employee, leave type, and leave period services. Handles pre-render logic to set up Vue components with employee, leave type, and leave period data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee data, leave type, and leave period properties, and sets permissions based on the request parameters.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds the leave type property to the component if leaveTypeId is specified in the request.

methods.name: addLeavePeriodProp
methods.description: Determines and adds the leave period property to the component based on request parameters or defaults to the current leave period.
